meta.source: Derived on 2026-10-27 from the Bonsai Design System structure (semantic token names, 14px base, borders-not-shadows) recoloured for NRC Connect: deep navy ink, a working blue, violet reserved for regulatory, green for done, dark purple-navy surfaces, IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono. Hex values are design choices for the NRC build, not measured from an NRC asset; confirm against the approved prototype before the first release.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The working blue. Primary buttons, links, active tab underline, focus ring, switch on, selected rows, chart series one. Text on surface: 5.8:1 light, 7.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed; brand text that must sit on brand-wash.

tokens.name: brand-contrast
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill. Dark theme lightens the blue, so its text is navy, never white.

tokens.name: brand-wash
tokens.usage: 12% blue wash: selected sidebar item, info notices, hover on brand chips, brand icon tiles.

tokens.name: brand-dark
tokens.usage: Deep purple-navy slab. Authentication side panels, the 404 and 500 pages, marketing surfaces, the cover. White text only.

tokens.name: brand-dark-2
tokens.usage: Second purple-navy for blocks and cards on brand-dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on surface, surface-2 and surface-3. Never pure black.

tokens.name: regulatory
tokens.usage: Violet, reserved. IRB gate, compliance check, adverse event clock, Part 11 signatures, audit entries. Never a decorative accent, never a chart colour outside regulatory views. Text on surface: 5.6:1 light, 9.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: regulatory-strong
tokens.usage: Regulatory button hover; regulatory text on regulatory-wash.

tokens.name: regulatory-wash
tokens.usage: Ground for regulatory alerts, the IRB badge, the compliance card header.

tokens.name: regulatory-contrast
tokens.usage: Text on a regulatory fill.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Green for done: completed, paid, enrolled, published, verified. Always paired with a word or check icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: done-wash
tokens.usage: Success notices, success page tile, done badge ground.

tokens.name: waiting
tokens.usage: Amber for waiting on someone: pending approval, awaiting IRB number, invoice sent, lead not yet contacted.

tokens.name: waiting-wash
tokens.usage: Warning notices and waiting badge ground.

tokens.name: blocked
tokens.usage: Red for blocked, failed, overdue, destructive. Text on surface 5.6:1 light. Differs from done in lightness, not only hue.

tokens.name: blocked-wash
tokens.usage: Error notices, field error ground, blocked badge ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels, modals, popovers, fields.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: App and page ground behind cards; sidebar ground.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Raised or hovered ground: row hover, disabled field, segmented control track, kanban column.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default 1px border on cards, buttons, inputs, table rows, dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Field border at rest, stronger separators, 3:1 control borders.

tokens.name: line-hair
tokens.usage: Hairline between list rows (ink at 8%, white at 10%).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, inactive tabs, ghost buttons, captions. 6.7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Column headers, placeholders, timestamps, axis ticks. 4.7:1 on surface; do not use smaller than 12px.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control text. Decorative only; below 4.5:1 by design.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on ink fills (tooltip, inverse chip).

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on brand-dark and brand-dark-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on brand-dark. 8.2:1.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Modal scrim.

tokens.name: tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltip ground; text is text-inverse in light, on-dark in dark.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series one. Enrolled, revenue earned.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series two, teal. Screened, invoiced.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series three, amber. Pending, spend.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series four, slate. Did not qualify, other.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series five. Only in regulatory views (audit volume, AE clock).

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart grid lines.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: Empty or placeholder bars, map land.

tokens.name: avatar-1
tokens.usage: Avatar ground, cycle one.

tokens.name: avatar-2
tokens.usage: Avatar ground, cycle two.

tokens.name: avatar-3
tokens.usage: Avatar ground, cycle three.

tokens.name: avatar-4
tokens.usage: Avatar ground, cycle four.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: body-lg

styles.name: code

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat card values and chart totals; tabular figures.

spacing.note: 4px base. Buttons 32/36/44 tall; inputs 36; table rows 44; sidebar 240 collapsing to 56.
